mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real GDP (more than 1% quarter-over-quarter) indicates a weakening economy, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between GDPC1 drops and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (more than 0.5% in one month) signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending is expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (more than 1% month-over-month) indicates a strong supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and consumer sentiment (proxied by RSAFS) also increases, it signals a strengthening demand side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% MoM and RSAFS increase
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS increases on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month, coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of PAYEMS decrease and UNRATE increase on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2% YoY) coupled with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 2%) signals accommodative monetary conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: low inflation, low interest rate environment
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of low CPIAUCSL and low FEDFUNDS on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% year-over-year, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in the last three months, signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 2% YoY and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of GDPC1 increase and UNRATE decrease on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
